source_evidence: D326~14:20 at Orsaven ordinary ferry landing counting office, V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar with paymaster; coach/four horses at Copper Hart. Player exact 'Yes lets go' accepts Cirren's suggestion to visit paymaster. Routine walk arrived14:10. Paymaster voluntarily shows operator's signed agreement for Quenwood's private eighth of net evening earnings, computed after crew wages. Replacement ferries continue operation. No current authorized claimant for outstanding eighth; paymaster retains separate recorded balance48gp (one eighth of384gp net evening earnings since last completed distribution). Newly fixed present scene figure, not recovered historical source amount or rolled result; paymaster's record/testimony, no independently counted funds, transfer, recipient dates, prior distribution sum, restitution or V ownership established. He agrees to notify Sgt Rill Desen/competent restitution authority and supply ledger evidence, holding funds until lawful direction; no actual notification or court allocation yet. He points out certain evening freight receipts unusually high relative to passenger takings; operator describes them as freight earnings, paymaster does not know cargo or sponsor. No proof of smuggling, guilt, active transfer, receiver or future sailing established. Coxswain can explain own runs if approached. Cirren wants recovery for families, optional further inquiry about freight. No new wages withheld, no seizure, booking, expenditure, roll, rest, or resource change. All prior party counters, custody, independent obligations and skiff/referral results unchanged. Await V's response; no automatic departure or expedition. Source pins dm-ferry-setup.md @300789a66801d87700502e1499b9cfbb15ff72b4, dm-ferry-i.md @8e5df88d508d558ed0907593bb84c8c65a6741ea, dm-ferry-ii.md @5b3e57c906b5e7bf90c45c870c42e320aaa01afa, D325 Desen disclosures. Genuine voluntary interview and new present fixed amount, no invented historic roll.
pending_action: D326~13:55 Orsaven boatyard, V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar on quay with proprietor/daughter and workers, coach/four horses at Copper Hart. R2 V exact 'just attack' authorizes ordinary ranged Psychic Blade only. Attack genuine d20 2+9=11 hits AC8, d6 face2+4=6 psychic, Large Ochre Jelly HP6→0; dead, no Split, no further hostile turns, no Vex, BA, Sneak Attack, reactions, spell slots or extra resources spent. Combat completed D326~13:36, both V and Cirren unharmed. Single 2014 MM Ochre Jelly defeated; R1 1MP already spent, no additional expenditure. Under previously accepted skiff help and fixed prep dm-ferry-i.md, after actual threat removal Fenar willingly works the line/lifting eye with yard workers while a competent worker seats replacement pin, correct leverage with no pressure means no roll; boom visibly lifted and rescue skiff released, routine cleanup of dead ooze handled by yard with due caution. No V action, hazard, purchase, wage, fee or reward invented. Daughter thanks party and offers future pilot/downstream pickup on a later crossing if arranged, no journey or service accepted or booked. Shipwright's original receipted bill and Quenwood guarantee previously revealed: two lost ferries, promised eighth of net evening earnings, beneficiary account4-C payment on guarantee; shipwright unaware source when paid; replacement operation active. Paymaster at ordinary ferry landing is next available lead, no current share sum, recipient, restitution or operator complicity established. Quenwood life imprisonment upheld, restitution unpaid. V has not yet visited paymaster; await next action. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP6/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Cirren51/51 AC19 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 shield/boots, no concentration; Fenar59/59 AC16 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40 breastplate/Insignia; natural+9/1d6+6 base or1d6+8 raging, mechanical greataxe unaffected. Mara and animals healthy, purse2049gp8sp6cp rations21/feed28 LR0/6, no qualifying rest or money changes. Royal invitation delivered, councillor sponsors exploratory reciprocal intelligence proposal, confidential Kestrel copies complete, actual royal reply pending; Crown frontier300+1300 contingent, no new liaison. Conditional service-house grant signed not title; Coris packet forwarding300gp pending, optional800gp field milestone. Two orders target353 with520gp unpaid; Serpent Dart unresolved. Elara Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed. All prior originals/custody unchanged. V dice delegated. Accepted play durable via immutable chunk; prior blocked owner synchronization not declared complete.  At D326~13:50 V tells shipwright's daughter exactly 'Actually you might have a job waiting for you near Miregate then'. She is interested in hearing about possible river work but helps run her father's active boatyard and will not abandon existing obligations on a vague offer. Asks what kind of work V has in mind, whether a particular boat/job or regular operation; willing to consider a commission or ongoing arrangement if mutually workable. No hiring, contract, wage, voyage, move, estate expense, staffing promise or task accepted; no roll or time skip. The previous offer of a pilot/downstream pickup remains. Await V's explanation; no further movement or paymaster visit.  D326~13:55 V exact 'Whatever my steward says we need! Give her the info and contacts and details' authorizes actual voluntary commercial introduction. Mara prepares and hands shipwright daughter a written introduction identifying Meret Halwick, chief steward at Miregate Keep responsible for Miregate, Reedbed and Old Distributary Fort, directions along known overland route from Orsaven (roughly three days under normal travel, no confirmed direct navigable connection), established service scopes (Miregate mill/storage/private berth; Reedbed repairs, handling, storage, freight coordination, owned two locally operational barges 12t/10t baseline; Fort riverworks/navigation safety under Crown authority), and invitation to discuss useful pilotage, repairs, freight contracts or other real needs directly with Meret. Meret's existing lawful available estate funds and staffing authority apply; no commitment to hire or guarantee wages, transport, job, residency, public navigation monopoly, current balance, live capacity, further estate spending or new route. Daughter accepts introduction, intends to discuss possible business with father and contact steward when practical; no dispatch, actual meeting, sale, travel or reply yet. V's personal referral is not a paid work contract. No Sending Stone use, courier, extra costs or roll. Prior rescue favor remains. Source: trackers/csv/property/miregate-setup.csv @d1b5025b8bcbad105db4089dd280a6b3f087b601; miregate-overview.csv @f5034b7f857930de62e8a9ae857a3f464c88c3e0; reedbed-overview.csv @86424b034dd5e3bbfee95e4218bd889ca3ad39ce; old-distributary-fort-overview.csv @5ace6a266d16a778329410153b723f80657931e6. Historical baselines only; no unverified current finances or commissioning asserted. Await V's next action; paymaster remains nearby and Cirren wishes to follow up.
